subject.why: The waterfall cave matches the brief with the cave entrance, inner glow, and rainbow spray.

category.why: Follows category 4 layout with water at the base and stylized sky in the background.

clean.why: No UI, text, borders, or characters present.

framing.why: The rock formation touches and is cropped by both the left and right edges, lacking side margins.

colour.why: Vibrant palette with nice warm interior lighting against the blue sky.

detail.why: Volumes are clean and stylized without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Renders with smooth, chunky 3D forms consistent with the references.

fix: Scale down the cave structure so it does not touch or get cut off by the left and right edges of the frame.
